scheduling_policy_manual.content: Sales Scheduling Policy v3.1: Always confirm the invitee's primary decision contact before scheduling. Use timezone-aware event types for international invitees. Confirmation emails to external prospects require AE review before send. Calendar invites for active negotiation-stage opportunities require AE sign-off. Do not add non-decision contacts to invites without the lead contact's consent.
